notes.title: Optimization Update
notes.content:
Hello, Heroes!
This update focuses on optimizing the game for better performance.
We've especially improved performance issues that caused significant lag in countries using specific languages.
Thank you for your support!

Also, our Patreon page is now live — we’d love your support and interest!
Enter the Game | Patreon

notes.title: 📢 Infinity Mode is Here!!
notes.content:
📝 \[System Message] — Heroes! New content has arrived!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45136498/fd885fe17abef5f3e32de9caa0e169f30e75bfc4.png"]  
💀 Endless Mode is Here!

Endless Mode has finally arrived! 
Now it’s time for the real champions to step up...  
Prove you’re the strongest by surviving to the very end! 💥 
Oh, and Discord integration? ✔️  
Your best records can now be posted for all to see. Show off that glory! 👀🔥

  
⏩ Speed-Up Mode Added!

The long-awaited Speed-Up Mode is now live!  
But… it’s not available from the start~ 😏  
Curious how to unlock it? You’ll have to play and find out. No hints from us—hehe.  


🛠️ Balance Adjustments Implemented!

To prepare for Endless Mode and upcoming stages,  
the **stack amount of permanent stacking skills** has been slightly reduced. 
The cooldown for Archery skills has been shortened overall!  
Stage 4 is now easier too — great news for new adventurers! 
🎯  

---  

That’s it for today’s update!

notes.title: Localization and Optimization
notes.content:
📝 [System Message] — Hey, Heroes!

🌍 The world is vast, and languages are many!  
French / Italian / Russian,  
Welcome our new heroes! ✨

🧊 Lag? Not anymore!  
We’ve fixed the suspected cause of minor lag issues that occurred in certain languages.  
Your gameplay should feel smoother now. 🛠️

🔥 June Update: Endless Mode is Coming...  
We’ve made some balance adjustments  
to prepare for the upcoming Endless Mode.  
└ Especially Stage 4 — the difficulty has been slightly lowered!

💥 Skill Renewal Complete!  
└ Treasure Hunter now gains more attack power on kills! Feels much more like a real hunter now.  
└ Playmer now fires one extra shot automatically when selected! Big value in real combat.

📦 This patch is a small step to make your journey even more fun.  
Look forward to the next update — and as always, thank you!

notes.title: New Stage & New Character 👑
notes.content:
📢 Hey, Warriors!
You thought the game was tough? Well, it was manageable, right? But where’s the fun in that? So, we decided to crank up the difficulty just a little bit. And as a special bonus… hmm… we slightly reduced the amount of gold and skill points you earn. Oops~ 😈

🔧 Optimizations & Improvements
Game Optimization – Smoother, faster, and more responsive! (It’s not shinier, but trust us, it feels better.)
Continue Game Feature – Got interrupted? No worries! You can now continue where you left off… unless you died. That’s still permanent.

🆕 New Content
New Stage – More places to meet your doom! Congratulations! 🎉
New Character – A fresh warrior joins the battlefield! Will they be a hero… or just another body on the ground?
New Skills – More ways to obliterate enemies… or yourself. Choose wisely.

⚖️ Balance Adjustments
Skill Balance Adjustments – Some skills were too powerful, while others were a bit underwhelming. We balanced them fairly, so no hard feelings, okay?
Potion Hotkeys (1 ~ 6) Added – No more scrambling for potions while on the verge of death. You’re welcome.
Stage Difficulty Increased – Everyone seemed a bit too comfortable, so we made things slightly more challenging. Have fun!
Gold & Skill Point Gain Reduced – Making money is tough in real life, so why should it be easy in the game? 💰

Now, get back into the dungeon and prove your worth! And… try to survive. You’ll need the luck.

notes.title: Update #02
notes.content:
Game Balance Adjustments
- The overall difficulty has been slightly increased, excluding the very early stages.
- The amount of gold earned and the amount required for upgrades have been adjusted.
- Some masteries have been adjusted.
- Skill appearance rates have been partially adjusted.


Class-specific Mastery Added
- A mastery that applies only to specific classes has been added.


Other Quality of Life Improvements
- Sound adjustment function added.
- Resolution memory storage has been enhanced.
- Potion descriptions added.


German Language Added

notes.title: New Stage Addition and Mastery System #01
notes.content:
Patch Notes:

- The 3rd stage has been added.

- The Mastery System has been implemented.

- Achievements have been added.

- Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese languages have been added.

- The cloud save path has been changed. Unfortunately, this may result in the loss of data from the prologue version, but it is a precautionary measure to prevent data loss when transitioning to the full version in the future.

- As compensation, we've temporarily increased gold acquisition rates significantly.

Enjoy the game!
